name: diamond_autoshare.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((F (mk-F (freal Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (freal Real)(dval Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((E (mk-E (freal Real)(eval Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (freal Real)(dval Int)(eval Int)(bval Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-F (sel-F F))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  (lift-E (sel-E E))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-F ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-F (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-F ((this Ref)) F
  (sel-F (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-E ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-E (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-E ((this Ref)) E
  (sel-E (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-F ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-F this)
    (deref-is-D this)
    (deref-is-E this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-D this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-E ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-E this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class F:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-F F)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class D:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-D D)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class E:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-E E)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-B B)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-F const-1-F))
        2 (lift-D const-2-D))
        3 (lift-E const-3-E))
        4 (lift-B const-4-B))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun const-1-F () F
  (mk-F 0.0))
(define-fun const-2-D () D
  (mk-D 0.0 0))
(define-fun const-3-E () E
  (mk-E 0.0 0))
(define-fun const-4-B () B
  (mk-B 0.0 0 0 false))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         1
                         (lift-F (mk-F 0.0)))
                  2
                  (lift-D (mk-D 0.0 0)))))
  (store (store a!1 3 (lift-E (mk-E 0.0 0))) 4 (lift-B (mk-B 0.0 0 0 false)))))
